units.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration
units.text: 14) early termination of the powers of a head of the municipality exercising the powers of head of the local administration;
units.label: Point 14 Part 1 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration
units.text: 15) failure to meet the deadline for issuing a municipal legal act necessary to implement a decision adopted through the population’s direct expression of will;
units.label: Point 15 Part 1 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration
units.text: 16) acquisition of foreign agent status.
units.label: Point 16 Part 1 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration
units.text: 2. The head of the local administration may be released from the position held by agreement of the parties or through judicial proceedings on the basis of an application by:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration
units.text: 1) the municipal representative body or the head of the municipality, in connection with violations committed by the head of the local administration concerning the resolution of matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life, and also in connection with failure to observe restrictions and prohibitions or to perform duties established by the legislation of the Russian Federation on combating corruption;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration
units.text: 2) the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, in connection with violations committed by the head of the local administration concerning the exercise of individual state powers delegated to local self-government bodies by federal laws and laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, and also in connection with failure to observe restrictions and prohibitions or to perform duties established by the legislation of the Russian Federation on combating corruption;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration
units.text: 3) the head of the local administration, in connection with violations of the conditions for holding the position of head of the local administration by local self-government bodies and/or state authorities of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration
units.text: 3. The head of the local administration may be released from the position held through judicial proceedings on the basis of an application by the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation in connection with failure to observe restrictions and prohibitions or to perform duties established by the legislation of the Russian Federation on combating corruption, identified through verification of the accuracy and completeness of information on income, expenditure, property and property-related obligations submitted in accordance with that legislation.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration
units.text: 4. If the powers of the head of the local administration terminate early, or if a court orders procedural coercive measures against the head in the form of detention in custody or temporary suspension from office, the powers are temporarily exercised by a local self-government official or an authorized municipal servant designated in accordance with the municipal charter.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration
units.text: 5. The highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation issues a legal act dismissing the head of the local administration from office where:
units.label: Part 5 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration
units.text: 1) the head of the local administration has issued a regulatory legal act conflicting with the Constitution of the Russian Federation, federal constitutional laws, federal laws, the constitution (charter) or laws of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation or the municipal charter, where such conflicts have been established by the relevant court and the head has failed, within two months after the court decision entered into force or within another period specified by that decision, to take measures within their powers to implement the court decision;
units.label: Point 1 Part 5 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration
units.text: 2) the head of the local administration has committed acts, including the issue of a non-regulatory legal act, entailing a violation of human and civil rights and freedoms; a threat to the unity and territorial integrity of the Russian Federation, its national security and defense capability, or the unity of its legal and economic space; misuse of earmarked interbudgetary transfers or budget loans; or violation of the conditions for providing interbudgetary transfers or budget loans received from other budgets within the budget system of the Russian Federation, where this has been established by the relevant court and the head has failed to take measures within their powers to implement the court decision.
units.label: Point 2 Part 5 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration
units.text: 6. The highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation may issue a legal act dismissing the head of the local administration from office under part 5 of this Article no earlier than one month and no later than six months after the entry into force of the latest court decision necessary for issuing that legal act.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration
units.text: 7. The highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation may dismiss the head of the local administration from office if, within one month after that highest official has issued a warning or reprimand to the head in accordance with part 7 of Article 29 of this Federal Law, the head has failed to take measures within their powers to eliminate the reasons that served as grounds for the warning or reprimand.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 23. Early termination of the powers of the head of the local administration
units.text: 8. A head of the local administration in respect of whom the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation has issued a legal act of dismissal from office may challenge that act in court within 10 days after its official publication.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 23

units.locator: Article 24. Control and accounts body of a municipality
units.text: Article 24. Control and accounts body of a municipality
units.label: Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Control and accounts body of a municipality
units.text: 1. For the purpose of external municipal financial control, the municipal representative body may establish a control and accounts body of the municipality.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 24. Control and accounts body of a municipality
units.text: 2. The organization and activities of a municipal control and accounts body are governed by Federal Law of 07.02.2011 No. 6-ФЗ “On the General Principles of the Organization and Activities of Control and Accounts Bodies of Constituent Entities of the Russian Federation, Federal Territories and Municipalities”, this Federal Law, the Budget Code of the Russian Federation, other federal laws and other regulatory legal acts of the Russian Federation, and municipal regulatory legal acts. In the cases and in accordance with the procedure established by federal laws, the organization and activities of municipal control and accounts bodies are also legally regulated by laws of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 24

units.locator: Article 25. Local self-government officials. Status of persons holding municipal offices
units.text: Article 25. Local self-government officials. Status of persons holding municipal offices
units.label: Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Local self-government officials. Status of persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 1. A local self-government official means a person holding a municipal office or having concluded a contract (employment contract) who is vested, in accordance with the municipal charter, with executive and administrative powers to resolve matters directly ensuring the population’s daily life and/or to organize the activities of a local self-government body.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Local self-government officials. Status of persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 2. Persons holding municipal offices include:
units.label: Part 2 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Local self-government officials. Status of persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 1) a deputy;
units.label: Point 1 Part 2 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Local self-government officials. Status of persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 2) the head of a municipality;
units.label: Point 2 Part 2 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Local self-government officials. Status of persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 3) the chair, deputy chair and auditor of a municipal control and accounts body;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Local self-government officials. Status of persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 4) other persons in accordance with a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation and the municipal charter.
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Local self-government officials. Status of persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 3. Persons holding municipal offices are provided with conditions enabling the unimpeded exercise of their powers.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Local self-government officials. Status of persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 4. The term of office of persons holding municipal offices is five years.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Local self-government officials. Status of persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 5. The provisions of part 4 of this Article apply taking into account the special features of the procedure for terminating the powers of a person holding a municipal office provided for by this Article.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Local self-government officials. Status of persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 6. A deputy’s powers begin on the day of election and terminate on the day the first quorate meeting of the new convocation of the municipal representative body is held.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Local self-government officials. Status of persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 7. The powers of the head of a municipality begin on the day of ceremonial assumption of office in accordance with the procedure provided for by the municipal charter and terminate on the day the newly elected head takes office.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Local self-government officials. Status of persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 8. The powers of a head of a municipality elected by the municipal representative body begin on the day of election by that body and ceremonial assumption of office in accordance with the procedure provided for by the municipal charter, and terminate on the day the new convocation of the representative body holds a meeting at which the election of the head of the municipality is considered.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Local self-government officials. Status of persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 9. A decision changing the procedure for electing (appointing) a person holding a municipal office applies only to persons elected (appointed) after that decision enters into force. A decision changing the list of powers of a person holding a municipal office applies only to persons elected (appointed) after that decision enters into force, except where the changes are made to bring those powers into conformity with the legislation of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Local self-government officials. Status of persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 10. Persons holding municipal offices may exercise their powers on a full-time basis in accordance with this Federal Law and the municipal charter.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Local self-government officials. Status of persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 11. Deputies of the municipal representative body generally exercise their powers on a non-full-time basis.
units.label: Part 11 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 25. Local self-government officials. Status of persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 12. No more than 10 percent of the established number of deputies in the municipal representative body may work on a full-time basis; if the representative body has fewer than 10 members, 1 deputy may do so.
units.label: Part 12 Art. 25

units.locator: Article 26. Guarantees for the exercise of powers by a person holding a municipal office
units.text: Article 26. Guarantees for the exercise of powers by a person holding a municipal office
units.label: Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Guarantees for the exercise of powers by a person holding a municipal office
units.text: 1. A deputy of the municipal representative body exercising powers on a non-full-time basis is guaranteed release from work by the employer with retention of their job (position) for a period whose duration is established by the municipal charter in accordance with a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation and may not total fewer than two or more than six working days per month.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Guarantees for the exercise of powers by a person holding a municipal office
units.text: 2. Guarantees for the exercise of powers by a person holding a municipal office are established by the municipal charter in accordance with federal laws and laws of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Guarantees for the exercise of powers by a person holding a municipal office
units.text: 3. If the municipal charter, in accordance with federal laws and laws of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, provides additional social and other guarantees to persons holding municipal offices upon termination of their powers (including early termination), the relevant charter provisions apply only to persons exercising powers on a full-time basis who reached retirement age or lost their capacity for work while holding a municipal office. They may not provide such guarantees to persons who held municipal offices and whose powers were terminated for failure to observe restrictions and prohibitions or to perform duties established by the legislation of the Russian Federation on combating corruption, or on the grounds provided for in points 1–3 of part 1 of Article 21, points 6, 7 and 10 of part 1 and part 2 of Article 30 of this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Guarantees for the exercise of powers by a person holding a municipal office
units.text: 4. Persons who have held municipal offices for the period specified in the municipal charter may be granted supplementary pension provision in addition to an old-age (disability) insurance pension awarded under Federal Law of 28.12.2013 No. 400-ФЗ “On Insurance Pensions” or awarded early under Federal Law of 12.12.2023 No. 565-ФЗ “On Employment of the Population in the Russian Federation”, in the cases, on the conditions and in accordance with the procedure provided for by the municipal charter in accordance with a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation. Expenditure associated with establishing supplementary pension provision is financed from the local budget.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Guarantees for the exercise of powers by a person holding a municipal office
units.text: 5. For the head of a municipality, a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation may establish guarantees associated with holding a state office of that constituent entity in addition to the guarantees established under part 2 of this Article. Expenditure associated with establishing those guarantees is financed from the budget of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 26. Guarantees for the exercise of powers by a person holding a municipal office
units.text: 6. Persons who have held the office of head of a municipality for the period specified by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, calculated from the date this Federal Law enters into force, may be granted supplementary pension provision in addition to an old-age (disability) insurance pension awarded under Federal Law of 28.12.2013 No. 400-ФЗ “On Insurance Pensions” or awarded early under Federal Law of 12.12.2023 No. 565-ФЗ “On Employment of the Population in the Russian Federation”, and in addition to supplementary pension provision established under part 4 of this Article, in the cases, on the conditions and in accordance with the procedure provided for by a law of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation. Expenditure associated with establishing such supplementary pension provision is financed from the budget of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 26

units.locator: Article 27. Meetings between a deputy and voters
units.text: Article 27. Meetings between a deputy and voters
units.label: Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Meetings between a deputy and voters
units.text: 1. Meetings between a deputy and voters are held in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation on assemblies, rallies, demonstrations, marches and picketing.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Meetings between a deputy and voters
units.text: 2. Local self-government bodies designate places specifically set aside for meetings between deputies and voters, and determine the list of premises they provide for such meetings and the procedure for making those premises available.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 27. Meetings between a deputy and voters
units.text: 3. Obstructing the organization or holding of meetings between a deputy and voters entails administrative liability in accordance with the legislation of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 27

units.locator: Article 28. Restrictions on persons holding municipal offices
units.text: Article 28. Restrictions on persons holding municipal offices
units.label: Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Restrictions on persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 1. Persons holding municipal offices may not be senators of the Russian Federation, deputies of the State Duma of the Federal Assembly of the Russian Federation or deputies of legislative bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, or hold other state offices of the Russian Federation, state offices of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, state civil service positions or municipal service positions, except in the cases established by this Federal Law or other federal laws.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Restrictions on persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 2. The head of a municipality may not simultaneously exercise the powers of a deputy of the municipal representative body.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Restrictions on persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 3. A deputy of the representative body of a municipality or the head of a municipality may not simultaneously exercise the powers of a deputy of the representative body of another municipality or the head of another municipality, except in the cases established by this Federal Law or other federal laws.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Restrictions on persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 4. Persons holding municipal offices who exercise their powers on a full-time basis may not:
units.label: Part 4 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Restrictions on persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 1) engage in entrepreneurial activity personally or through authorized persons;
units.label: Point 1 Part 4 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Restrictions on persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 2) participate in the management of a commercial or nonprofit organization, except in the following cases:
units.label: Point 2 Part 4 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Restrictions on persons holding municipal offices
units.text: а) participation without remuneration in the management of a political party or a trade union body, including an elected body of a primary trade union organization established in a local self-government body, or participation in a congress (conference) or general meeting of another public organization, a housing, housing construction or garage cooperative, or an association of real estate owners;
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 2 Part 4 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Restrictions on persons holding municipal offices
units.text: б) participation without remuneration in the management of a nonprofit organization (other than participation in the management of a political party or a trade union body, including an elected body of a primary trade union organization established in a local self-government body, or participation in a congress (conference) or general meeting of another public organization, a housing, housing construction or garage cooperative, or an association of real estate owners), with prior notification of the highest official of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation in accordance with the procedure established by a law of that constituent entity;
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 2 Part 4 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Restrictions on persons holding municipal offices
units.text: в) representing the municipality’s interests without remuneration in the council of municipalities of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation, other associations of municipalities, and their governing bodies;
units.label: Subpoint «в» Point 2 Part 4 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Restrictions on persons holding municipal offices
units.text: г) representing the municipality’s interests without remuneration in the governing bodies and audit commission of an organization of which the municipality is a founder (shareholder or participant), in accordance with municipal legal acts determining the procedure for exercising a founder’s powers on behalf of the municipality or the procedure for managing municipally owned shares (participatory interests in charter capital);
units.label: Subpoint «г» Point 2 Part 4 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Restrictions on persons holding municipal offices
units.text: д) other cases provided for by federal laws;
units.label: Subpoint «д» Point 2 Part 4 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Restrictions on persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 3) engage in other paid activities, except teaching, scientific and other creative activities. Teaching, scientific and other creative activities may not be financed exclusively from the funds of foreign states, international and foreign organizations, foreign citizens or stateless persons, unless otherwise provided by an international treaty of the Russian Federation or the legislation of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 3 Part 4 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Restrictions on persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 4) be members of governing bodies, boards of trustees or supervisory boards, or other bodies of foreign nonprofit nongovernmental organizations and their structural subdivisions operating in the Russian Federation, unless otherwise provided by an international treaty of the Russian Federation or the legislation of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 4 Part 4 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Restrictions on persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 5. Persons holding municipal offices must observe the restrictions and prohibitions and perform the duties established by the legislation of the Russian Federation on combating corruption.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 28. Restrictions on persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 6. Persons holding municipal offices who exercise their powers on a full-time basis may not participate as defense counsel or representatives (except in cases of statutory representation) in civil, administrative or criminal proceedings or in proceedings concerning an administrative offense.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 28

units.locator: Article 29. Liability of persons holding municipal offices
units.text: Article 29. Liability of persons holding municipal offices
units.label: Art. 29

units.locator: Article 29. Liability of persons holding municipal offices
units.text: 1. The powers of a person holding a municipal office terminate early if the person fails to observe restrictions and prohibitions or to perform duties established by the legislation of the Russian Federation on combating corruption, unless otherwise provided by this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 29
